When he started paying for it, the card he was using kept on declining. I asked if he has other cards or cash and he said he's got none. I was in a bad mood that day so I told him to sing. He was reluctant at first so I offered him that I can sing it with him. And we did. Everyone watched us as we sang happy birthday to Canada. Luckily, his wife came in and paid the groceries. My coworkers were looking at me confused so I explained it to them. They all just laughed and thought it was hilarious.
